bayts.text: And make these letters of mine lights, O You Who turned perdition toward others.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "Peace" (As-Salām) and "Giver of security" (Al-Muʾmin),
bless with a blessing that keeps my life safe from all through which darknesses come,
with a peace that turns the others away from my heart and draws the good
to love of me, without rancour, O You Who host me, Who have bestowed the dwellings on me,
upon him whose service made my dwellings good for me and granted me Your guidance.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me security in every refuge, and through him make my life the best of benefactions.
And make my pens, my ink and the tongue callers to the Possessor of Beauty, with fair things.
And make my writing such that it brings to the Gardens, illumining my heart.
O Allah, O Lord of the Throne and the Footstool, O You Who gift Your most holy secret,
bless with a blessing that guarantees success for me, forever, with You, O Guardian (Al-Muhaymin),
with a peace that comes with righteousness, that leads to me the ḥadīth like the verses,
upon him to whom I gave my ink, with pens that my affection led.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And write for me today a sweetness that lasts in all You have chosen for me, O Everlasting, Eternal.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
bless with a blessing that guards my inhabited dwellings from abandonment, O You to Whom fortification belongs,
with a peace that sets the limbs right, that illumines mornings and evenings for me,
upon him who drove the enemies toward other than my person, and removed illness.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make through him, O my Sovereign, my concerns clarity from faults and healing from illnesses.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "All-Powerful" (Al-Qadīr) and "Able" (Al-Qādir),
And bear witness for me, forever, that I have turned from the enemies to You, and that I acknowledge
(Your favours) with remembrance and gratitude, without ingratitude, O You Who encompass the house with the neighbours.
blessing and greeting with peace the Prophet, who surpasses every near one and stranger.
Bless with a blessing that makes gifts everlasting, blessed, that prevent sins
from turning toward me, perpetually, upon the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad,
his Family and his Companions; and raise to You my worship and my custom, by Your grace.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "All-Hearing" (As-Samīʿ) and "All-Seeing" (Al-Baṣīr),
bless with a blessing that makes righteousness everlasting for me, that makes success firm for the Gardens,
upon him whom my pens gladden, without delusion and without reproach,
with a peace that turns away every guile, and it departs forever toward others than me,
upon him who repelled those who wished to expel (him), formerly, for their unbelief, with gradual ruin,
toward other than what was chosen for me of the lawful; and he led to me the best of piety and gain.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my passing, my dwelling and the houses witnesses for me of the most excellent good things.
And make all my houses mosques, O You Who repel whoever does not prostrate
toward other than what grieves me, wherever he has turned, O You Who opened for us the gate of the Gardens.
O You Who protected all my being from misery, its people and everything that leads to misery,
bless with a blessing that makes my wishes sound, O best Healer: truly You are the One Who restores,
with a peace that illumines my mind, in the present, O Illuminer, and in the future,
upon him who drove illness away from me, and drove away Satan and the enemies.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make sound (the affirmation of) Oneness and the words, and make sound the deeds and the states.
And drive out the leaning against me from the hearts of people who hated me, and make milk everlasting for me.
And make the outpourings of my breast illumine the hearts of Your party, and make its light shine.
And make my writing and my word, with You, the truth of certainty (Qurʾān 56:95), joy for Your hosts.
And raise my creeds, my word and deed, made sound, to You, and draw hope to me.
And make my life, O Beautiful, a shield (junna) against harm, for me a garden (janna) for the Garden.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have conveyed to me the prices of what was sold from me, without revocation, with the glory of Rabīʿ.
To You my gratitude, after a lasting praise; on my behalf reward forever my mother and my father
with abundant good, (making them) both well pleased with me; and be for me with generosity and favour.
And bless on my behalf, forever, the Prophet, lamp of every near one and stranger,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
